result.title: KoalaGS: Complexity-Aware Continuous Level of Detail for Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: Deploying a trained 3D Gaussian Splatting scene under shrinking compute budgets requires one primitive set to remain effective when rendered at smaller prefixes. In this continuous level of detail (LoD) setting, the challenge is to decide which Gaussians should retain capacity as the budget decreases. A pilot study on 3DGS-MCMC reconstructions shows that image complexity, computed from the input views before optimization, predicts where reconstruction error concentrates in image and 3D space. It also reveals that simple regions contain too many Gaussians and degrade as much as complex ones at lower budgets, despite being inherently cheaper to represent. Subsequently, in KoalaGS, during training we use this complexity prior to bias relocation toward poorly reconstructed areas while ensuring smooth degradation across LoDs. A primitive importance score then enables inference at low-capacity, while preserving the scene structure. Tested across three datasets, KoalaGS maintains competitive full-capacity quality while significantly improving quality across the budget spectrum, yielding smoother transitions across LoDs, and enabling faster progressive streaming.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 3D Gaussian Splatting 在计算预算持续收缩时的连续 LoD 问题，用优化前由输入视图算出的图像复杂度作为先验，在训练中把高斯容量向重建较差区域重分配，并借助原始重要性分数支持低容量推理与更平滑的降级。
AI.relevance_reason: 「按复杂度/重要性在预算收缩下分配表示容量并保证平滑降级」的思路，可能与 LVR 中动态计算预算、latent 状态保留与取舍的决策问题有概念联系，但任务与模态差异大，仅可供核查。
